'''Elaiza''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] from [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]] who survived the [[Great Jedi Purge/Legends|Great Jedi Purge]].

==History==
[[File:Elaiza_on_the_run_JoY.png|thumb|left|200px|Elaiza on the run from [[Bespin Wing Guard/Legends|Bespin Wing Guard]]]]
Elaiza was a Jedi during the final days of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. Near the end of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], she had been overwhelmed with the horrors of war and left on a [[Meditation/Legends|meditative]] retreat. It was for this reason she escaped the execution of [[Order 66/Legends|Order 66]] and the rise of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire]]. After learning of the fall of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]], Elaiza went into hiding on her homeworld of Nar Shaddaa, also called the Smugglers' Moon. There she hid from the Empire and its [[Jedi hunter/Legends|Jedi hunters]] among the teeming masses of life crowding the moon.

At some time during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], Elaiza's aging [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] began to fail and a new [[Lightsaber crystal/Legends|lightsaber crystal]] was required to repair it. She traveled to [[Cloud City/Legends|Cloud City]] to participate in an auction for the [[Jewel of Yavin/Legends|Jewel of Yavin]], a valuable [[Corusca gem/Legends|corusca gem]] she planned to cut down to create a new crystal for her Jedi weapon.
